hero.title: Voice-based screening for neurological disorders
hero.description: Neuronous develops voice-based technology for neurological screening. A short voice sample is analyzed computationally to identify patterns relevant to screening — designed to support early awareness, not to provide a diagnosis.
hero.note: Screening supports awareness and early conversation — it does not replace a clinical diagnosis.

problem.title: Accessible neurological screening matters
problem.description: Earlier identification of potential neurological indicators can support timely follow-up. Yet neurological assessment often depends on specialized clinical settings and expertise that may not always be easily accessible.
problem.earlyText: Earlier identification of potential neurological indicators can support timely follow-up and evaluation.
problem.accessText: Neurological assessment can require clinical expertise and specialized settings, which may not always be readily available.
problem.voiceText: Voice contains measurable acoustic and temporal characteristics that can be computationally analyzed and studied in relation to neurological conditions.

hero.title: Turning Voice Into a Signal for Neurological Screening
hero.description: Neuronous analyzes acoustic and temporal characteristics of the voice using computational methods to identify patterns that may be relevant to neurological screening. It is designed to support screening — not to provide a diagnosis.

whyVoice.title: Voice carries measurable information
whyVoice.description: Speech and voice contain acoustic and temporal characteristics — such as pitch, rhythm and stability over time — that can be described computationally. Neurological changes can influence these characteristics, which is why voice is being studied as a measurable signal for screening.

hero.title: Privacy & Data Protection
hero.description: Privacy is central to how Neuronous approaches voice-based screening. This page explains — in plain terms — how we think about data, what is involved in the screening process, and the principles that guide our work.
hero.note: This page describes principles and structure, not a finalized legal policy. Specific operational details will be published as they are confirmed.

intro.title: Why privacy matters to Neuronous
intro.description: Screening technologies work with information that is personal. Because our approach is built on voice, we take the responsible handling of that information as a starting condition for the technology — not as an afterthought.
intro.body1: Voice is one of the most personal signals a person can share. It carries identity, expression and context. Any screening technology that works with voice therefore has an obligation to treat that data with care, and to be transparent about what it does with it.
intro.body2: This page describes the principles that guide our approach to privacy and data protection. It is written to be readable rather than legalistic, and it reflects our current understanding of the responsibilities involved in building a voice-based screening technology.

voice.title: Voice and audio in the screening process
voice.description: The screening process is built around voice. Understanding what that means — and what role voice data plays — is part of understanding how the technology works.
voice.whatText: Voice data refers to recordings or derived representations of a person's voice that are captured during the screening process. These signals are the input to the analysis step.
voice.roleText: The voice signal is processed computationally so that measurable characteristics can be analyzed. The result of that analysis contributes to a screening output — it is not a medical diagnosis.
voice.sensitivityText: Voice can carry information beyond the words being spoken. For this reason, voice data is treated as sensitive information and handled with the same care as other personal data.
